primary.message: PROVISIONAL verdict: qualifies. D9b (registry_learned_e (D9 + (e) constraint)) is selected: highest on-time (73.3%) among the candidates that meet every assessable criterion (not assessable for it: C6, C8 = insufficient data). Per candidate: D8 fails C1 [pooled] (0.333 vs 0.550), C2 [listed] (0.455 vs 0.850), C7 [pooled] (-0.033 vs 0.150); insufficient data: C6 (n=7 < 15), C8 (n=6 < 8); D9 fails C3 [pooled] (0.055 vs 0.050), C4 [pooled] (0.203 vs 0.100), C5 [pooled] (0.235 vs 0.100); insufficient data: C6 (n=7 < 15), C8 (n=6 < 8); D9b meets every assessable criterion; insufficient data: C6 (n=7 < 15), C8 (n=6 < 8); D9c meets every assessable criterion; insufficient data: C6 (n=7 < 15), C8 (n=6 < 8). Provisional per SPEC_V3 AMENDMENTS 2-3.
primary.recommendation: D9b meets the assessable criteria on fresh data, but the verdict is PROVISIONAL (AMENDMENTS 2-3: no stale stratum, a weak missing stratum, freeze after the labels) and a provisional qualifier is NOT recommended as the registry default by this spec. Under the Recommendation rule it would become the RECOMMENDED monitor when a valid registry is configured (still opt-in); that decision is the maintainer's, knowing these limits. The default monitor is unchanged.
